text:
Alex Chen: Quick triage — we need final alignment on launch commitments for Monday. Specifically: SLA targets, pricing buckets, support coverage, and runbook handoff. Who owns what?

Mira Patel: I can take the SLA doc and the acceptance checklist. Will update the draft by EOD. :white_check_mark:

David Ortiz: Heads up — billing needs clear mapping for burst/steady states. Last pricing matrix didn't handle sustained 10k rps.

Sofia Ramos: Monitoring/alerts here. I propose these SLOs: p95 latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5% and an automated regression alert tied to eval set. Thoughts?

Alex Chen: @Sofia p95 120ms sounds reasonable for hosted; for Dedicated we should allow a looser SLO but stricter error thresholds. Add a note about model-variant fallbacks.

Priya Singh: Support coverage: we'll need 24x5 for GA, escalation to oncall-sre after sev2 for first 3 months. Can someone own the runbook for canary rollback?

Mira Patel: I'll link runbook skeleton into the SLA doc. For rollback steps can we standardize on: 
```
- cut traffic to canary
- switch routing policy to fallback model
- scale up dedicated pool if possible
- notify stakeholders
```

David Ortiz: For pricing, suggest pricing buckets: "dev" (low rate limit, free tier), "standard" (metered), "dedicated" (commit + discount). Need clear overflow billing when autoscale triggers. I'll draft numbers and run a quick finops calc.

Sofia Ramos: Also adding telemetry checklist: token-level cost, KV-cache hit rate, batch sizes, and model variant fallback counts. Those feed Optimize recommendations.

Alex Chen: Good. Two outstanding asks: 1) Final SLA wording (owner: Mira) 2) Billing overflow policy (owner: David). Also we need signoff from Legal on data residency note before we ship Private.

Priya Singh: I'll schedule a 30-min handoff with oncall and support docs review tomorrow 10:30am. Adding support runbook owners: @Priya, @Alex.

OpsBot: Deploy window reservation created for 2026-04-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please ack if launch depends on that window.

Alex Chen: Acked.

Mira Patel: Quick question — do we include a promised latency SLA for embeddings endpoints or mark them as "best-effort"?

Sofia Ramos: Embeddings will be best-effort for GA. We can publish median latencies in docs and commit to p95 in Dedicated later. I'll update monitoring to separate text-gen vs embeddings.

David Ortiz: FYI I'll include a billing backstop: if autoscale costs exceed 150% of committed, customer notified and given 72h to adjust, otherwise we throttle non-critical routes. Need product/legal ok.

Alex Chen: Product okay with that backstop as a conservative safety net. @Priya ensure customer communication templates are ready.

Priya Singh: Will prepare templates and post them in #customer-success.

Mira Patel: I'll push SLA draft PR and ping for review when done.

Alex Chen: Thanks all — wrapping up: owners recap: SLA = Mira, Billing policy = David, Monitoring = Sofia, Support/runbook = Priya + Alex. We'll reconvene after SLA PR review. :rocket:
